definitions.full: H6582. pashach [ מָּשַׁח ] verb Pi`el tear in pieces (Late Hebrew מָּשַׁח ; Aramaic מְּשַׁח 1Sam 15:33 (Agag), , ); — Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix וַיְפַשְּׁחֵנִי Lam 3:11 (of lion, in figure).
